name: OpenRCA
description: OpenRCA is a benchmark for evaluating AI models on root cause analysis tasks. For each failure case, the model receives 1 point if all generated root-cause elements match the ground-truth ones, and 0 points if any mismatch is identified. The overall accuracy is the average score across all failure cases.
reputation: Root cause analysis benchmark for AI models on system failures
notes: Evaluates ability to identify root causes in failure cases.
